services.name: Christ of the Abyss
services.desc: This iconic statue is one of the most famous sites visited by snorkelers Duration 3 Hours About Donated to Key Largo in 1965, this is a memorial for all who have lost their lives at sea. This iconic statue is one of the most famous sites, visited by snorkelers and divers from around the world. It is located in a beautiful section of the reef in John Pennekamp State Park and is surrounded by many soft corals and a wide array of fish. The statue depicts Christ's offering of peace. As the top of the statue is only 11 feet underwater it is easily accessible by most novice snorkelers. This makes this particular site a perfect location for snorkeling. Included Snorkeling gear & flotation devices

services.name: Private Sunset Cruise Key Largo
services.desc: Tranquility in the Keys Duration 2 Hours About The Florida Keys are world renowned for their captivating sunsets! Set out on this evening cruise from the southern side of the island admiring the immensity and sheer beauty of the Atlantic Ocean. Enjoy a scenic passage through the natural mangrove sanctuaries watching for native birds, manatees, and dolphins. Then we'll head out to sparkling waters where you will witness the sun gently slip into the ocean. A tranquil experience to end your perfect day in Key Largo. services.desc: The Florida Keys draw visitors from around the world to admire the many unique species of native wildlife & sea life. Step aboard for a round trip from one side of the island to the other while observing many of the beautiful areas surrounding Key Largo. We will begin our journey from the southern side of the island, admiring the immensity and sheer beauty of the Atlantic Ocean. Enjoy a scenic passage through the natural mangrove sanctuaries that are home to an array of native birds, fish, manatee and dolphin.
